name: Event Ledger / Chronology
description: Dated observations, events and revisions. Incident logs, history, audit trails and case timelines.
reference_use_case: Incident logs, history, audit trails and case timelines.
integrity_rule: An event log is not necessarily current state or causal proof.
antipattern: Do not equate a timestamped observation with established causality or current state.
design_question: What happened, when, according to whom and with which revision?
situational_schema: Events, revisions, timestamps and provenance are recorded without assuming causality.
